name: Wirtshaus des Admirals
description: The Admiral's Inn — Heide Park's finest sit-down restaurant located in the heart of the atmospheric Bounty Land pirate area, serving hearty German and European dishes in a beautifully themed tavern setting with wooden beams, nautical decorations and the warm glow of lanterns. The Wirtshaus des Admirals is the place for a proper sit-down meal with table service, a wide menu of meat dishes, fish, salads and desserts, and a selection of German beers and wines. The pirate-themed ambiance makes it one of the most memorable dining experiences in any German theme park.

name: Piraten Burger
description: A lively pirate-themed burger restaurant serving generous portions of freshly made burgers, chicken strips, loaded fries and soft drinks in a fun swashbuckling setting. Piraten Burger is one of the most popular quick-service dining options at Heide Park — centrally located, reliably good and always busy on peak days. Perfect for families wanting a fast, satisfying meal between rides.

name: Bulls and Bandits
description: A rugged Western-themed grill restaurant located in the Desert Race area serving smoky grilled meats, ribs, pulled pork and hearty cowboy-style sides in a dramatic frontier setting complete with saloon decor and country atmosphere. Bulls and Bandits is Heide Park's most distinctive food concept — a real alternative to standard theme park fare with authentic barbecue flavours and generous portions that satisfy even the hungriest thrill-seeker.
